sobre.title: Who I am today
sobre.paragraph1: I'm Claudia and yes, I am another career changer pivoting into tech. But just like anyone with a real story, my background is uniquely mine. Here is a bit of my trajectory so you can see how I can add real value to your team.
sobre.paragraph2: I spent years working in education and gastronomy. While vastly different, these fields taught me everything about people, clear communication, organization, and acting under pressure. Now, I'm building my career in technology, translating my background, curiosity, and critical thinking into solutions that make sense for both users and businesses.
sobre.paragraph3: Currently studying Systems Development at SENAI, I also learn continuously through online courses and tech communities. I'm always testing and applying this knowledge in practical, hands-on projects that you can explore in this portfolio.
sobre.paragraph4: My goal is to keep expanding my skill set to build functional solutions for real-world problems. The transition hasn't been a walk in the park—and that's completely fine. It comes with challenges, discoveries, and plenty of bugs along the way, all of which only make me stronger. I hope I've managed to share a bit of who I am in a clear and direct way.
sobre.paragraph5: I'm looking for an entry-level tech role where my maturity and user-first perspective can enrich the team. I want to keep growing my technical toolkit with accountability and drive. If you made it this far, I hope you enjoy the projects and that we find a great reason to connect.

items.descricao: Web application that turns real municipal spending data into clearer, easier-to-explore information.
items.detalhes: End-to-end project: I processed and organized public data from PMSJ with Python and Pandas, then built the interface in React with filters, key indicators, and visualizations to make public spending easier to understand.

items.descricao: Power BI dashboard for exploring revenue, spending, and fiscal indicators from São José, Brazil.
items.detalhes: I worked with real data from the Transparency Portal, preparing it in Power Query, modeling the data, and creating DAX measures to build financial indicators.

items.descricao: Institutional website developed in collaboration with the PyLadies Floripa community.
items.detalhes: I contributed React components, accessibility and mobile performance improvements, and replaced generic images with real project content.

items.descricao: Logic game built to practice integrating JavaScript with a Python API.
items.detalhes: Full-stack project built to practice Flask routes, front-end and back-end communication, DOM manipulation, and state management.

items.descricao: Personalized academic learning platform with AI, courses, learning paths, and progress tracking.
items.detalhes: Full-stack application featuring user authentication, role-based access control, course and lesson management, video playback, learning paths, and AI integration. The project uses a separate frontend, API, and database architecture, with the frontend deployed on Vercel, the backend on Render, and PostgreSQL on Neon.

items.descricao: Content-focused website project exploring CMS structure, organization, and SEO.
items.detalhes: Practical project focused on exploring CMS structure, content organization, plugins, performance, and good practices for web publishing.
